def transform(g):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    L=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if 2 in r and all(x==2 for x in r)][0]
    fours=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==4]
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    out[L]=g[L][:]
    for (i,j) in fours:
        if i<L: step=1; sgn=-1   # move down; away = up
        elif i>L: step=-1; sgn=1 # move up; away = down
        else: step=0; sgn=0
        if step==0: continue
        ni=i+step
        if ni==L:  # blocked by the line -> move away instead
            ni=i-sgn if False else i+ (sgn if False else -step*0)  # simplify below
        # compute moved cell: one step toward line; if that is the line itself, one step away
        ni = i+step
        if ni==L:
            ni = i-step  # away
        out[ni][j]=4
        if abs(ni-L)==1:
            away = -1 if L>ni else 1
            for t in range(1,max(h,w)+1):
                rr=ni+away*t
                if not (0<=rr<h): break
                for c in (j-t,j+t):
                    if 0<=c<w:
                        out[rr][c]=4
    return out
